rules.rule: This is a public, unauthenticated landing page. Never embed a Supabase service-role key, or any other secret/service credential, in client-side code — only the public/anon key belongs here.
src/routeTree.gen.ts is generated by `bun run generate-routes`. Flag any manual edit — fix the route files under src/routes/ and regenerate instead.
The 3D hero (react-three-fiber/three) and visual effects are decorative. Flag changes that add heavy synchronous computation or large asset loads to the initial render path of the landing page.
